name: Sep 2024 - Mar 2025 drawdown
description: Replay of the slow five-month decline from the Sep 2024 Nifty 50 high.
rationale: Peak-to-trough of Nifty 50 closes in our cache: 26,216.05 on 2024-09-26 (its highest close up to then) to 22,082.65 on 2025-03-04 (-15.77%), 109 sessions. A slow drawdown, unlike the event shocks.
caveats: Commonly attributed to sustained foreign portfolio outflows and weaker earnings (verify against a market commentary source before citing a cause).
Over a 109-session window the buy-and-hold assumption matters more than in a one-day shock: weights drift as assets move apart.
